name: print-social-becrea-creativity-stories-collage-orange-teal-halftone
title: 'Creativity Never Ends' BeCrea story set with collage-style photo cutouts, halftone dots and orbit lines
whatItMeans: Eclectic and artistic; mixing collage cutouts, spray texture and orbit lines makes a creativity school feel genuinely experimental.
whatItIs: Nine story cards on cream-to-orange gradients with collaged black-and-white photo cutouts of people, glasses and cameras, spray-paint texture, thin orbit-line circles with small planets, star confetti, and headlines ('Creativity never ends', 'Explore Your Creativity', 'Unleash your Creativity').
techniques: Collage cropped photo cutouts at varied angles and sizes.
Add spray-paint texture for a raw, artistic feel.
Scatter small orbiting planet motifs alongside collage elements.

vocabulary.definition: A cropped photo element layered irregularly with others.
A speckled paint-like effect used for grit.
